svg.title: Side by side comparison of eight instruments, as stored in the app's comparison page. Index funds (Nifty 50): expected 10 to 14%, medium risk, high liquidity, no lock in. ELSS: 12 to 15%, medium risk, medium liquidity, 3 year lock in, 80C deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh. PPF: 7.1% guaranteed, low risk, low liquidity, 15 years. NPS: 9 to 12%, medium risk, very low liquidity, until age 60. Short term debt funds: 7 to 9%, low risk, high liquidity, no lock in. Gold ETF or SGB: 8 to 12% including interest, low risk, SGB locked 8 years. Emergency fund in a liquid fund: 4 to 6%, low risk, very high liquidity. Fixed deposits: 6 to 7.5%, low risk, medium liquidity, 1 to 5 years. The page also compares tax benefits, expense ratio and minimum investment.

div.p: The comparison page lines up returns, risk, liquidity, lock in, tax benefit, cost and minimum investment.

section.p: Return bars span 0 to 15% a year. Figures are the reference values stored in the app, not live market data or guarantees.
